label: Higgsfield Video Generation
description: Higgsfield text-to-video or image-to-video using seedance_2_0 (default), veo3_1, kling3_0, or soul_cast. Supports start/end frame input, audio, and Soul ID character locking.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Video motion prompt. Describe subject, action, camera movement, environment, and style.

start_image.label: Start Frame
start_image.description: First frame image for image-to-video generation. Maps to shot.startFrameImage.

end_image.label: End Frame
end_image.description: Last frame image for guided generation. Maps to shot.endFrameImage.

audio.label: Audio Track
audio.description: Audio file to sync with generated video.

soul_id.label: Soul ID
soul_id.description: Higgsfield Soul ID for character consistency. Auto-resolved from cast character's providerRefs.higgsfield.soulId when available.

negative.label: Negative Prompt
negative.description: Elements to exclude from the video.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: Write video motion prompts for Higgsfield in this order: [subject or reference anchor] [specific action with kinetic verbs] [camera movement] [environment and lighting] [style]. Keep under 150 words for single shots. For seedance_2_0, use the AI filmmaking rules: default to 15 seconds unless the user explicitly requests less, prefer storyboard-driven prompting when a storyboard grid exists, keep style language consistent across shots, and default to NO MUSIC. Use strong motion verbs: drifts, surges, slams, crawls, flickers. One concept per sentence. When a Soul ID is available from the character's providerRefs.higgsfield.soulId, set the soul_id field — do not describe the character's face in the prompt when soul_id is set.

field_guides.prompt: What happens in this shot. Subject + action + camera + environment + style. Stay under 150 words for video models.
field_guides.model: seedance_2_0 for cinematic narrative; veo3_1 for high-quality renders; veo3_1_lite for budget/quick renders; kling3_0 for fast stylized video; soul_cast for Soul ID-locked character video.
field_guides.duration: Use 15s by default for seedance_2_0 unless the user explicitly asks for a shorter clip. Match story.skel duration only when the shot has an intentional shorter editorial duration.
field_guides.start_image: Use shot.startFrameImage path when available. Enables image-to-video generation for scene continuity.
field_guides.end_image: Use shot.endFrameImage path for guided endpoint generation. Useful for match cuts.
field_guides.soul_id: Look up the shot's character_refs → find matching character in studio.json → read providerRefs.higgsfield.soulId. If found, set this field and omit face description from prompt.

examples.action: Harlan walks to the window and looks out at the storm

output.prompt: Walks to the rain-streaked window, gripping the frame, and stares into the churning darkness below. Slow push-in from behind. Stone lighthouse interior, single lantern light casting long shadows. Cinematic noir, shallow depth of field.

do: Check character_refs on the shot and resolve soul_id before writing the prompt
Use soul_cast model when a soul_id is available
Use start_image from shot.startFrameImage when set
Prefer storyboard-grid guidance when a storyboard reference is available
Default to NO MUSIC unless the user asks for music or dialog
dont: Describe the character's face when a soul_id is set — the Soul ID handles consistency
Exceed 150 words for the prompt field on video models
Use the word 'camera' inside the prompt text
Re-describe a character's face when a Soul ID or character reference sheet is already anchoring identity
